# Copilot Instructions, AI Context and Agents

## Description / Background / Objective / Context / Purpose *(REQUIRED)*

Establish and document the copilot instructions, context, and agent roles for this project. This includes creating comprehensive onboarding guides, configuration files, best practices, and tips/tricks for effective use of AI agents. The initial focus is on the "Technical Business Analyst" and "Code Reviewer" agents, outlining their responsibilities, workflows, and feasibility considerations. Documentation should be creative and engaging, utilizing code examples, Mermaid diagrams, tables, and graphs where appropriate.

## Requirements / Acceptance Criteria / Definition of Done *(REQUIRED)*

- Copilot instructions and agent context are documented in markdown format in the `.github/issues` folder
- Roles and responsibilities for Technical Business Analyst and Code Reviewer agents are clearly defined
- Includes onboarding guides, configuration instructions, best practices, and tips/tricks
- Documentation contains creative elements (e.g., code samples, Mermaid diagrams, tables, graphs)
- All content is self-contained, actionable, and easy to follow for new team members
- No dependencies on other tickets or systems

## Technical Specifications / Implementation Details / Scope of Work *(REQUIRED)*

- Create a markdown issue file named `5-copilot-instructions-ai-context-and-agents.md` in `.github/issues`
- Reference only project files, documentation, and resources within the repository
- Define agent roles, workflows, and feasibility considerations
- Include onboarding steps, configuration details, and usage guidelines
- Use Mermaid diagrams, tables, and code samples to illustrate concepts
- Ensure adherence to INVEST principles

## Risk Assessment / Mitigation / Dependencies / Blockers / Assumptions *(OPTIONAL)*

- No current dependencies or blockers
